programme: Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting and Finance
official_facts: The programme prepares students for professional accounting qualifications and finance leadership.
The structure includes a professional core in accounting and a required minor in finance, with an option to take a second major in finance.
Accounting training and finance are both substantive programme components.

major_signals.look_for: Understanding how classification, measurement or reporting choices affect financial interpretation; correct use of revenue, gross profit and costs.
Financial reasoning about investment, capital allocation, trade-offs or risk, tied to evidence.
Verification of assumptions, correction of analytical errors and appropriately bounded conclusions.

overclaim_warnings: Do not equate revenue with gross profit.
Do not give higher scores merely for mentioning a professional accreditation or a financial institution.

sources.title: HKU Admissions: BBA Accounting and Finance

interpretation_note: major_signals are evaluation heuristics inferred from programme content, not a published admissions marking scheme. Confirm exact 2027 requirements at submission.
